selected_question.name: Non-color Focus / Selection State Grammar
selected_question.question: Can one restrained structural grammar distinguish default, keyboard focus, selected, focus+selected and disabled states across neutral APP-like and WEB-like carriers without depending on candidate color, motion, iconography, imagery, material, bespoke typography, semantic status meaning, product-specific vocabulary, or CLR-01?
selected_question.scope: Bounded supporting state-treatment mechanism only; no semantic-state selection, product interaction behavior, production component token, final identity or implementation authority.

isolation_law: Keep constant neutral text, grayscale carrier, system typography, control content and state semantics.
Candidate families may vary only non-color structural treatment of focus and selection.
Disabled is a non-scored accessibility/comprehension stress state.
No gradients, imagery, iconography, motion, material texture, bespoke glyph/type, brand marks, product status hues, Character state, Stage semantics or CLR-01 family values.
Focus and selection are independent channels; combined state must retain both.
Browser :focus-visible must survive; forced-colors must preserve distinguishishable structural state; 320px must not horizontally overflow; reduced-motion adds no animation/transition.

matrix.F2: Ring + Edge Witness — candidate; vertical inline-start witness in APP, low horizontal witness in WEB.
matrix.F3: Ring + Opposing Brackets — candidate; tests authored geometry against edit/crop interpretation.
matrix.F4: Weight + Depth — stress candidate; dotted focus plus static weight/depth selection.

pre_registered_hard_checks: exact 4-family / 8-context / 40-specimen logical matrix; 16 aria-pressed selected and 8 disabled
focus-only, selected-only and combined mechanically distinguishable
focus+selected retains selection carrier plus focus outline
disabled remains disabled and not selected
no horizontal overflow at 1200 and 320 CSS px
forced-colors preserves focus and structural selection for F2/F3; F1 may reduce to generic platform-compatible calibration; F4 cannot rely on box-shadow
reduced-motion source contains no authored animation/transition identity carrier
no image/svg/icon/custom font/gradient/filter/brand/CLR family token in scored carrier
subjective_falsification_after_clean_pre: focus and selection collapse into one state
selection primarily reads as edit/crop/resize affordance
state carrier becomes more authoritative than content
APP and WEB cease to read as one underlying mechanism
mechanism is too generic to add useful identity beyond platform convention
mechanism implies product semantics absent from neutral fixture
